research.title: Evaluate, Simplify, and Translate Expressions — Prealgebra 2e §2.2
research.retrieved: Official HTML translation section, operation-language table, contrasted grouped-sum examples and context interpretation. No full book ingestion or external image reuse.
research.adopted: Identify what a variable measures; distinguish multiplying a whole sum from adding after a product; read the expression back into its context.
research.rejected: Do not use a keyword-to-operation lookup as sufficient modelling. Do not introduce full equation solving, powers or multi-variable algebra as entry requirements.
research.usageRestrictions: Current page states CC BY-NC-SA and separate AI/commercial permission restrictions. Mathematical facts used for conceptual comparison only; no source wording, exercises, images or code copied. No open permission for protected reuse inferred.

research.title: Equivalent Expressions
research.retrieved: Official task, commentary, worked solution and licence footer.
research.adopted: Accept commutative and distributed forms that preserve the quantity. A counterexample can disprove equivalence; structural reasoning supports identity.
research.rejected: A small set of numerical probes is not used as an exact general equivalence proof. Do not turn the forming process into matching only.
research.usageRestrictions: CC BY-NC-SA4.0 stated. No task wording or figures copied; own Finnish contexts and SVG.

research.title: 1.4 Simplifying and manipulating expressions, equations and formulae
research.retrieved: Official KS3 overview and key-idea link labels; linked full teacher documents and videos not claimed read. Copyright page retrieved in this production conversation.
research.adopted: Generalising number structure and interpreting letters underpin algebraic notation; retain the distinction between formation and manipulation.
research.rejected: Overview is not efficacy evidence or a complete lesson treatment; rearranging formulae/binomial products are outside this lesson.
research.usageRestrictions: NCETM default Crown/OGL with attribution and named-author/third-party qualifications. No external media or text copied.

planning.purpose: Represent the structure of a verbal situation by constructing an expression, not merely choosing one.
planning.teacherObjective: Oppilas nimeää muuttujan tarkoittaman määrän, jäsentää toistuvan ja kerran tulevan osan, muodostaa lausekkeen sekä tarkistaa sen merkityksen.
planning.childGoal: Muodostan tilanteesta lausekkeen ja tarkistan, mitä sen osat tarkoittavat.
planning.hook: Two extra cards once or in every one of three bags?
planning.concreteToRepresentation: Paper bags/cards → original grouped diagram → optional numeric model → variable/group expression → learner construction/read-back.
examples: 3n+2: three equal groups and two once.
3(n+2)=3n+6: each group includes two extra; compare at n3 gives15 versus11.
Adjacent stick squares:4+3(n−1)=3n+1;4n double-counts shared edges.
planning.interaction: Open text or reusable native token buttons; exact bounded affine coefficient checker accepts commutation, repeated addition and expansion. Separate model switch/n-slider/rule-help preserves response feedback.
scope: One variable n, supported small whole-number constants and affine expressions using +,−,multiplication,parentheses.
Positive integer context values; ribbon0<n<20; model n1–6.
No division/powers/multi-variable/nonlinear expression support or full free-creation assessment.
planning.repair: Correct→edit token/text/target→neutral→check wrong/incomplete→repair alternative→correct. Exact check reads visible string and target. Syntax/scope refusal does not label unsupported algebra mathematically false.
planning.transfer: Construct formula for shared-edge stick chain, plus remainder ribbon; optional invent own context offline.
limits: Finite supported construction with supplied contexts does not demonstrate unprompted full process, own explanation, retention, independent/formal mastery or efficacy.
Finite numeric counterexample feedback disproves wrong affine forms; correctness uses exact coefficients, not sampling.
Geometry shape Lite branch invokes perimeter context; this authored lesson supplies the stick relation instead of adding M-GMEAS-01 as required.
